visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair tied in a ponytail stands on a green turf golf mat at an outdoor driving range. She is wearing a grey sweatshirt and black leggings with white sneakers. Her hands are positioned firmly on the grip of a golf club as she stares down at a ball. The background is a wide, flat grassy field with several target markers and large green netting structures under bright, natural daylight. (2) The woman executes a full golf swing, her body rotating as the club makes contact with the ball. Her facial expression is focused during the movement. The club follows through over her shoulder, and the ball is propelled into the distance across the range. (3) She lowers the golf club and turns towards the camera, walking forward with a cheerful and relaxed smile. As she approaches the lens, the text on her sweatshirt becomes visible. The lighting remains bright and consistent as she moves from the hitting mat towards the foreground, adjusting her hair slightly.

The background is silent except for a very faint outdoor atmosphere. (2) A sharp, loud impact 'clack' sound occurs, representing the golf club striking the ball. Immediately after the strike, a rhythmic Phonk-style electronic track fades in with a heavy, distorted bass beat and synthesizer layers at 124 BPM. (3) The electronic music continues as the primary audio layer, featuring a consistent, high-energy beat. A subtle sound of fabric movement and light outdoor wind is heard as the subject walks towards the microphone, while the music maintains a steady volume until the end.
